text:
Maya: quick idea — propose we split the Optimize toolkit launch into two parallel tracks: Advisor (customer-facing recommendations) and Ops (runbook + eval-alerts). keeps rollout risk lower and lets us ship batching/caching Q2 bits earlier.
Leo: +1 on the split. can we make Advisor read-only for beta customers (no auto-apply)? less product risk. :thumbsup: 
Sam: must clarify acceptance criteria per track. suggest minimal gates: 1) Advisor: regression <=1% on sentinel set, UI + API + docs, clear opt-in. 2) Ops: alert plumbing, playbook, canary fallback config, and on-call runbook.
Jin: follow-up — quant recommendations need SLA-tier mapping. some customers expect p99 latency guarantees; quant trades latency for quality. propose a "safety profile" schema so teams can pick conservative/medium/aggressive.
Maya: sketch of safety profile config: 
```
profile: "conservative"
apply_auto: false
latency_p99_target_ms: 250
quant_bits: 8
fallback_model: "llama-2-13b-fp16"
```
this should be included in Advisor recs and used by Ops runbook for fallback behavior.
ops-bot: deploy-check: optimize-advisor service on staging passed smoke tests at 2024-11-08T16:12Z :white_check_mark:
Leo: eval-triggered alerts should be actionable. propose two primary alert types: "quality drift" (model metric drop) and "cost spike" (unexpected tokens-per-request). both should surface suggested mitigations.
Anya: for drift alerts include failing prompts + top 3 mitigations, e.g., revert to previous model variant, tighten prompt constraints, or disable quant for matching requests.
Sam: suggest a compact rule DSL for alert criteria. example: 
```
rule: "eval_drift_v1"
metric: "topk_accuracy"
threshold: "-0.02"
window: "7d"
actions: ["notify#product","suggest_revert","create-incident-draft"]
```
machine-readable + UI-editable.
Maya: runtime needs to expose model variant + quant profile metadata per response so Ops can do fast fallbacks. small headers in API responses: `x-rw-model`, `x-rw-quant-profile`.
Jin: risk callout — automatic fallback could cause cost spikes if it falls back to larger FP models. Ops runbook must include cost-safety throttle and rollout caps.
Leo: next steps: (1) product to draft acceptance checklists per track (Maya + Sam), (2) infra to prototype headers + fallback hooks (Jin), (3) research to generate quant safety curves on sentinel sets (Anya). sync Friday?
Maya: Friday works. I'll post the two checklists to #product-docs today and open a short PR to add header instrumentation to staging proxy so we can simulate fallback behavior.
Anya: I'll run experiments with 3 customer workloads to produce perf vs quality curves for bits={8,4,3} and share a short table.
Sam: tiny ask — alerts should include an `eval_url` to the run that triggered them to speed triage.
Maya: agreed; include `eval_url` in alert payloads.
Leo: prioritization recap: (A) headers + fallback hook prototyping, (B) eval->alert rule DSL + UI, (C) advisor opt-in flow + docs. thanks all. :rocket:
